summary: hetzner.hcloud dropped ansible-core 2.12 and Python 3.7 support, needs hcloud-python 1.20.0, and its inventory no longer sets image_id, image_os_flavor and image_name when the server has no image.
questions: Why are image_name host vars missing in my hcloud inventory?

answer_card.title: hetzner.hcloud breaking changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- Dropped **ansible-core 2.12** and **Python 3.7**.
- Requires **hcloud-python 1.20.0**.
- Inventory: `image_id`, `image_os_flavor`, `image_name` are **not set** when the server has no image; use `default()` in templates.
